recap.text: Fan boxes open in the Over City. Donut draws a framed photograph of Bea and Brad. Carl draws a xistera, a wicker-looking scoop reaching two and a half feet past his hand that straps to his arm and hurls inventory items, making his slingshot redundant.

Carl loads a Banger Sphere, a baseball-sized ball of dwarven robot scrap made at the engineering table. He hits a babababoon in the neck instead of between the eyes, and it dies. He throws two more spheres at two mobs on the platform at 283, and they die too.

An emergency box from the Open Intellect Pacifist Action Network holds an attachment for one crawler and one purpose. Screwed onto the end of the scoop, it lets Carl throw Samantha five hundred metres for every point of strength. Removing the slot brings her back to him.

The plan uses teleport traps, two keys, and Samantha arriving where she cannot walk. Quan Ch surfaces at Ren's exit. Carl throws her over downtown to the capitol with the scoop and teleports in behind her.

Every crawler's inventory swaps hands and Donut holds Carl's. Donut tells Xistera to combine a bomb with an enriched pet biscuit. Donut takes the result and puts it down Scolopendra's throat with the scoop, and she comes apart into a puddle.

beats.headline: Voted in by an audience
beats.text: The first fan boxes come open in the Over City. Donut draws a framed photograph of Bea and Brad. Carl draws a xistera: a wicker-looking scoop reaching two and a half feet past his hand that straps to his hand and arm and hurls whatever he pulls out of his inventory into it, adjusting itself around the shape of the thing. It makes his slingshot redundant.
beats.gist: Carl draws a xistera, a wicker-looking scoop that hurls inventory items, making his slingshot redundant.

beats.headline: Banger Spheres
beats.text: The close fighting on the trains has kept it mostly idle this floor. On the platform at 283, Carl loads a Banger Sphere, one of a few hundred baseball-sized balls of dwarven robot scrap he made at the engineering table; the system names only that size. The first catches a babababoon in the neck when he was aiming between the eyes. It dies anyway. He throws two more at the two mobs on the other side of the platform, and they die too.
beats.gist: Carl throws baseball-sized Banger Spheres of dwarven robot scrap to kill a babababoon and two mobs.

beats.headline: A slot on the scoop
beats.text: An Emergency Platinum Benefactor Box from the Open Intellect Pacifist Action Network pops out a curved piece of glowing wicker. Carl extends his xistera, and the device slides easily onto the scoop. He will not be able to retract the xistera like this, but its purpose is clear. Outside, he shoves Samantha face-first into the slot, turns ninety degrees and chucks her with all his might, over fifty kilometres.

beats.headline: Ren's exit
beats.text: The plan runs on teleport traps, two keys, and Samantha arriving somewhere she cannot walk to. Quan Ch surfaces at Ren's exit. Carl throws her over downtown to the capitol with the scoop, then teleports in behind her.
beats.gist: Carl throws Quan Ch with the scoop to the capitol and teleports in behind her.

beats.headline: A ball, a biscuit and an open mouth
beats.text: Eris's effect swaps the inventory of Carl and each nearby crawler with the crawler closest to them, and Donut is holding Carl's. He has her combine the ball in slot ten of his hotlist with the biscuit in slot twelve. Hers has only ten slots, so she searches and combines, and drops the ball into the scoop as it forms on his arm. Carl puts the bike down to launch them into the air and flings it into Scolopendra's open mouth: a banger sphere carrying an enriched pet biscuit. The final dungeon boss splatters into a gelatinous puddle.
